About CoVar
CoVar is a small, mission-driven AI/ML R&D software company  based  in Durham, NC and McLean, VA. We build advanced software and machine learning systems that help the  DoW  detect threats in high-stakes environments and enable biomedical researchers to accelerate discoveries that save lives. Our team is composed of curious, passionate engineers who care deeply about using AI to solve real-world problems that matter.

You  may  have the opportunity to present your work to high-level  customer s in the  Do W  and  in the  industry.
